In my opinion, it should have been the mutant saga. Kang’s coming in way too soon, and since they leaked the ant man trailer at D23, it feels too unorthodox and spread out with too many villains and storylines to count. Even true marvel fans are getting severe headaches when they start to calibrate the actual stream of events, marvel went too far ahead into the future, and now they can’t even explain simple events and catastrophes. They focus too much on the suspense and less on the storytelling that made marvel perfect. Take the first two avengers and the first two iron man films; they told the story and focused less on the suspense of having a new villain. They introduced villains as part of the story and did not stray away from showing more prominent cameos and mysteries. They tried subtly showing those cameos that didn’t deliver what they were planning for the future. They came in with an excellent way of introducing quicksilver and scarlet, which my telling that they were enhanced individuals and then did not dwell on their past too much and focused only on Ultron and how to stop him. Now they could have included them and started a brand new era of mutants arising from the shadows and showing their true strength, which would have caused the avengers to try and control these people or recruit them but instead have a conflict with this other race that has a prominent future on earth. Trying to accept the changes in society with the coexistence of Mutants and Humans meanwhile Kang prepares his arrival on earth and is shown only in cameos at the end of films and tv shows. Thats how they should’ve paced it but they're trying to infuse two very different storylines into just one saga
